newsitem.title: UK: Dicom up on newspaper buy recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Dicom up on newspaper buy recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Dicom Plc, a European distributor of document image processing (DIP) equipment, rose on Monday after a recommendation in the Sunday Times newspaper following its acquisition of Austrian distributor Elsat.
The share was up 15p at 420p at 0915 GMT, though no trading was recorded in the stock.
The Sunday Times "Inside Track" column gave Dicom a "buy" recommendation and said: "the growth attractions make the the shares appealing".

DIP products allow the user to index, archive, display, and print images of original documents through personal computers. The DIP market is growing at roughly 20-30 percent a year, the Sunday Times said.

Dicom is the largest distributor of such equipment in continental Europe, the newspaper said, adding that its main product accounted for 28 percent of the European market, worth between 1.2 bln stg and 1.5 bln stg in 1994.
